name: The Claremont Resort
insider_take: This historic Berkeley Hills retreat has been the Bay Area's crown jewel since 1915, where tennis legends are made and spa indulgence meets breathtaking views.
whats_special: Home to 10 championship tennis courts where Olympic athletes and pros train year-round, plus the only resort-style spa in the East Bay with panoramic views stretching from San Francisco to the Golden Gate Bridge. The property's castle-like architecture and 22 landscaped acres create an old-world European estate feel just minutes from UC Berkeley.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the Bayview Lounge - it's the best-kept secret for Golden Gate Bridge views without the San Francisco crowds, especially magical during winter's clear evenings.
dont_miss: The legendary Sunday brunch on the terrace overlooking three bridges, and a treatment at the spa's outdoor cabanas where you can hear the UC Berkeley Campanile bells chiming across the hills. Tennis enthusiasts should try a lesson on the same courts where Brad Gilbert and other legends perfected their game.
pros: Historic luxury resort with stunning San Francisco Bay and city views
Expansive 22-acre property with beautiful gardens and tennis courts
Prime Berkeley Hills location near UC Berkeley campus
Full-service spa and multiple dining options on-site
cons: Large resort property may feel less intimate
Historic building with some dated room features
